node.statement: The inversion covariance holds. Fix U,c and put W=u_delta(U^dagger), H=h_delta(U^dagger). The inverse identity gives U^dagger=Pi_delta(W,H)=W bold-dot H. By 1.8, (cU)^dagger=conj(c)U^dagger=(conj(c)W) bold-dot H=Pi_delta(conj(c)W,H). Both (conj(c)W,H) and the inverse pair of (cU)^dagger lie in the displayed domain and have the same Pi_delta image. Injectivity of Pi_delta makes the pairs equal, whence sigma(cU)=u_delta((cU)^dagger)=conj(c)W=conj(c)*sigma(U).
